translations.web: We haven’t obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
translations.bsb: and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God to walk in His laws, which He set before us through His servants the prophets.
translations.kjv: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
translations.asv: neither have we obeyed the voice of Jehovah our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
